content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela face significant hurdles when it comes to online commerce. Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often restricted, leaving creators without effective solutions to sell their products. This guide outlines how to build a crypto store using Cloudflare Pages, enabling seamless transactions without dependency on conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-trap-most-creators|The Payment]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-my-unfiltered-take-3|payment]] processors. By leveraging COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can deploy a robust digital store that offers full control and ownership over your sales operations.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of traditional payment platforms to support creators in certain regions creates a need for infrastructure that empowers ownership and control. COREMERCH's approach enables you to build your store on decentralized technology, reducing reliance on external platforms and their limitations. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you ensure that your store remains operational regardless of regional restrictions. This model champions infrastructure sovereignty, allowing you to thrive in an environment that often sidelines creators.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deployment, gather the necessary tools and accounts. Create a Cloudflare account to manage your site's DNS and serve your pages. Set up a GitHub account, where your store's code will reside. You will also need a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Familiarize yourself with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-explained-digital-12|COREMERCH guide to google]] Apps Script, as it will facilitate backend functionalities for your store. Having these components in place will streamline your setup process, ensuring a swift deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery pipeline, start by configuring NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. Follow the integration guide provided with your COREMERCH materials to link your store's backend with NOWPayments. Next, utilize Google Apps Script to automate order processing and ensure files are delivered upon payment confirmation. This setup allows you to manage transactions efficiently and guarantees that customers receive their products immediately after payment, enhancing their overall experience.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you own your store entirely—no dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Push your code to GitHub and deploy your site using Cloudflare Pages. After deployment, conduct a test transaction using a small amount of cryptocurrency to verify that the payment processing and delivery pipeline work correctly. Monitor the transaction through NOWPayments to ensure everything operates smoothly. Once confirmed, promote your store and start processing real transactions, welcoming customers to your newly established digital commerce platform.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your crypto store, consider scaling your operations. Begin by adding more products to your inventory, leveraging the seamless integration of NOWPayments to handle increased transaction volumes. You can also enhance your marketing efforts to reach a wider audience. Monitor customer feedback and product performance to identify opportunities for improvement. As your store grows, you may explore advanced features within the Edge Commerce Stack, which offers additional capabilities to optimize your digital storefront.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 can be deployed in 4-6 hours and utilizes GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments to handle transactions. Stack 02, available for $197, is deployed in 48 hours with additional features, giving you a more robust setup for your store.
Automate payments and delivery for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting a digital product store. They provide free hosting options and support for custom domains, allowing you to establish a professional online presence.

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to diverse customer preferences. This extensive range ensures that you can accommodate various payment options to enhance customer satisfaction.
